summary: Independent adversarial audit of the available D1-D11 snapshot: 36 main-chain claims enumerated and classified (14 genuine-general, 7 conditional, 13 model, 2 statement-only); all certificate/record fields expanded with types and defect flags; the D11 heat test-function defect VALIDATED by a kernel-checked counterexample proved against the real Poincare.D7.HeatKernel.HeatKernelData field (continuous test function exp(y^4) makes the Gaussian-kernel integrand non-integrable for every t>0, so no HeatKernelData on R with Lebesgue volume and the standard Gaussian kernel exists); the D7 recognition deliverable expanded and classified as a CONDITIONAL assembly (recognition bridge, van Kampen, connected-sum and extinction inputs all unproved) - not a sphere-recognition theorem; blockers recounted from evidence (31 entries: 23 open, 1 documented, 1 resolved-in-worktree, 3 environment, 3 informational); machine-readable ledger with declaration types, fresh source hashes (66 package + 37 recompiled snapshot modules), axiom cones, dependencies and constructed-input status delivered. No builder source modified; no blocker claimed closed; no research-level discovery claimed.

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.not_initialCondition_gaussian
proved_declarations.type: ¬ D7InitialConditionAt gaussianKernelXY 0  (the D7 initialCondition field, verbatim at x = 0 on R with Lebesgue volume, is false for the standard Gaussian heat kernel)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.not_initialCondition_gaussian_quantified
proved_declarations.type: ¬ (forall x f, Continuous f -> Tendsto (fun t => integral y, gaussianKernelXY x y t * f y) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (f x)))

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.integrand_not_integrable
proved_declarations.type: 0 < t -> ¬ Integrable (fun y => gaussianKernelXY 0 y t * testFunction y) volume  (the integrand with the continuous test function exp(y^4) is not Lebesgue-integrable for every t > 0)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.integrand_lintegral_eq_top
proved_declarations.type: 0 < t -> lintegral y, ENNReal.ofReal (integrand t y) = ∞

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.tendsto_testFunction_atTop
proved_declarations.type: Tendsto (fun y => exp (y^4)) atTop atTop  (the test function is a concrete unbounded continuous function: non-vacuity of the counterexample)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.quartic_dominates
proved_declarations.type: 0 < t -> y ∈ [R t, ∞) -> y^4/2 <= y^4 - y^2/(4t)  (polynomial domination of the Gaussian decay)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.lowerConstant_le_integrand
proved_declarations.type: 0 < t -> y ∈ [R t, ∞) -> lowerConstant t <= integrand t y  (the integrand is bounded below by a positive constant on a half-line of infinite measure)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.real_initialCondition_specializes
proved_declarations.type: forall D : HeatKernelData R, x, f, Continuous f -> Tendsto (fun t => integral y, D.kernel x y t * f y dD.volume) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (f x)) (real field restated)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.realField_unsatisfiable_by_gaussian
proved_declarations.type: not exists D : HeatKernelData R, D.volume = volume and D.kernel = gaussianKernelXY (proved against the REAL rebuilt D7 structure)

D11_heat_test_function_defect.defect_content: test-function hypothesis is only `Continuous f`; no integrability, boundedness, compact-support or growth condition.
D11_heat_test_function_defect.why_overstrong: On a noncompact space a continuous test function can grow faster than the Gaussian decay; the integrand then fails to be integrable for every t > 0 and the (undefined, hence 0) Bochner integral cannot converge to f x ≠ 0.
D11_heat_test_function_defect.lean_proof: Poincare.D12.SemanticLedger.not_initialCondition_gaussian (R^1, test function exp(y^4), standard Gaussian kernel).
D11_heat_test_function_defect.d10_status: Poincare.D10.HeatKernelEuclidean proves heat equation / mass / semigroup but NO initial-condition theorem; no bridge from D10 to the D7 interface exists in the snapshot.
D11_heat_test_function_defect.repair_task: D12-heat-domain-repair (separate worker); this audit does not repair, it validates.
